description_html:
A well-presented two bedroom flat with a bright living space with a Juilet balcony, separate kitchen with integrated appliances, two double bedrooms, a family bathroom and an en-suite bathroom in the main bedroom. This property comes with a long lease ( approx 969 years) and is being sold chain-free by the current owners.

The property is situated within walking distance of the Elizabeth Line at the Barbican tube station, and the many bars and restaurants the City and Clerkenwell has to offer. Further transport links include the Metropolitan Line, Circle Line and Hammersmith & City Line from Barbican Station, with the Northern Line also accessible via a 7-minute walk to Moorgate Station.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 969
Service Charge: £5,262 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £200
Council Tax Band: F
